settings.opencode_url_help: Address of your headless opencode server. Start it with opencode serve (default port 4096).
settings.opencode_intro: OpenCode is an open-source, AI-native coding agent that runs locally in your terminal. It powers the AI replies generated by this extension. Visit the site to learn more and to configure it on your server.
settings.opencode_username_help: Username for basic auth. Defaults to opencode if left empty.
settings.opencode_password_help: Optional. The value of OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD if you started the server with basic auth enabled.
settings.opencode_agent_help: Preset that shapes how the assistant replies. build — answers right away; plan — thinks the answer over first. Both ship with opencode; leave the default for a simple direct reply.
settings.opencode_system_prompt_help: Optional free-text instructions for the assistant's behavior, sent with every message.
settings.opencode_system_prompt_placeholder: e.g. Call yourself Pupsik and answer in Russian.
settings.model_help: Type provider/model (e.g. opencode/big-pickle). Leave empty to use the server's default model.
settings.model_list_hint: Click a model to fill the field:
settings.model_no_free: No free models were found on the reachable providers.
settings.model_load_fail: Could not load the model list from the opencode server. Check the connection and try again.
settings.user_prompt_help: Enter the user id that will be used to generate AI responses.
settings.user_prompt_badge_help: Text that will be displayed below the assistant user.
settings.enable_on_discussion_started_help: When enabled, AI replies only at discussion start. When disabled, the discussion becomes a chat between the OP and the assistant; the assistant replies to every OP post.
settings.actions_help: Check the connection to the opencode server, or close all active sessions to free memory.
settings.connection_success: Connection successful. The opencode server is reachable.
settings.connection_success_default_model: Connection successful. No model set — the server default {model} will be used.
settings.connection_success_no_model: Connection successful. No model set — the server default will be used.
settings.connection_fail: Connection failed. Make sure the server is running and credentials are correct.
settings.session_count_result: Sessions on the server: {total}. Extension sessions: {extension}.
settings.session_count_fail: Could not count sessions. Check the connection first.
settings.sessions_close_fail: Could not close sessions. Check the connection first.
settings.max_active_sessions_help: Maximum number of opencode sessions kept in memory simultaneously. Oldest sessions are closed first. Set to 0 to disable the limit.
settings.max_messages_per_session_help: Maximum number of AI replies allowed per session before it is closed to free memory. Set to 0 to disable the limit.
settings.session_ttl_days_help: Sessions idle for longer than this many days are closed to free memory. Set to 0 to disable the TTL.
settings.retry_attempts_help: Total number of attempts (including the first) for each request to the opencode server. Failed requests are retried after the delay below. Set to 1 to disable retries.
settings.retry_delay_seconds_help: Seconds to wait before each retry. 0 means no delay.
settings.enabled_tags_help: Select in which tags the assistant will generate responses.
settings.enabled_tags_empty: The flarum-tags extension must be enabled to choose tags.
